facts.text: £3,280 per module in 2026/27 (Oct 2026 to Sep 2027). It rises annually with inflation, so a second module in 2027/28 will cost a little more.
Software Testing runs once a year at the Department; the listed date is 1 March 2027. No formal prerequisites, but programming in an object-oriented language is essential (taught in Java).
Short modules are not a master's degree, so they do not touch your one-time master's loan.

options.label: Birkbeck MSc (evenings)
options.blurb: Strongest pay credential and open to non-computing graduates, but it uses your one master's loan.
options.feeNote: £6,180 a year part-time for two years (home, 2027-28 entry).
options.stepNote: Two years of evening classes, October to July
options.nextAction: Book the online aptitude test and check the application dates.

keyDates.label: Apply and take the aptitude test

facts.text: MSc Computer Science: part-time two years, evening classes two to three times a week, October to July. Latest listed entry is October 2027.
Part-time home fee £6,180 a year for 2027-28 (full-time £12,360). Fees may rise with inflation.
Conversion route is open: at least a 2:2 in any subject other than single-honours computer science, plus an online aptitude test (once per academic year).
No fixed closing date is listed; Birkbeck advises applying early.

options.label: RCA one-year MA
options.blurb: Biggest name and network. One year full-time.
options.feeNote: £17,850 home fee for September 2027 entry; assumed unchanged for later entry.
options.nextAction: Draft the 300-word personal statement and the portfolio description.

facts.text: Contemporary Art Practice MA: 180 credits, 1 year / 45 weeks, full-time. The page says the first MA intake is September 2027.
Home fee £17,850 for September 2027 entry (MFA second year £14,650). £1,000 deposit, offset against fees.
Next application deadline shown as 8 Jan 2027. The page has inconsistent dates, so confirm with the RCA before relying on it.
Portfolio: curated recent practice, written description of how it relates to contemporary art, 300-word personal statement, video of up to two minutes.

options.label: Ruskin MFA, Oxford

options.feeNote: Fee not found on the Oxford pages I could read. Check the Ruskin MFA funding page.
options.nextAction: Read the Ruskin MFA fees and funding page and note the real cost.

facts.text: Full-time, expected length 9 months over three eight-week terms; start 10 October 2027.
Final application deadline for 2027-28 entry: 12:00 UK time on Tuesday 5 January 2027.
Fees and living costs were not listed on the page. Whether a nine-month course qualifies for the master's loan needs checking (the loan rules cover 1 to 2 academic years full-time).

options.label: Slade MA, UCL
options.blurb: Strong painting and sculpture name, two years full-time and the priciest tuition here.
options.feeNote: £16,800 UK fee for 2027/28 entry; two years, so I doubled it (assumes the same fee in year two).

facts.text: Fine Art MA: two calendar years, full-time only, starting September 2027.
UK fee £16,800 for 2027/28 entry (international £40,800). The page does not give a deadline, only that late applications are not considered.
Needs a portfolio, a personal statement and one reference; shortlisted candidates are interviewed.

options.label: RCA/Imperial IDE MA/MSc
options.blurb: Art and engineering together, strongest for pay and tech, but two years out of work.
options.feeNote: £20,350 for year one (September 2027 entry); year two is TBC, so I assumed the same.
options.nextAction: Check the two-part IDE application and portfolio brief.

facts.text: Two years full-time, 360 credits. Entry October 2027 per Imperial, September 2027 per the RCA page.
Home fee £20,350 for year one (September 2027 entry); year two TBC.
Postgraduate Master's Loan of up to £13,206 (2026/27 amount) for eligible home students, split £6,603 in each year.
Entry: 2:1 or equivalent in any subject, plus creative and technical aptitude; two-part application.

facts.text: UKRI minimum doctoral stipend from 1 October 2026: £21,805, or £23,805 with London weighting. Part-time students get a pro-rata amount.
A Doctoral Loan of £31,122 is available for 2026/27 PhD starters who normally live in England, but it will not cover the tuition fee in most years.
The RCA lists Doctoral Landscape studentships (Net Zero Futures, Creative & Caring Communities) and says there will be no further LAHP application rounds.
Stipend tax status is not stated on the UKRI page, so check before assuming it is tax-free.

rules.text: The Postgraduate Master's Loan is £13,206 for courses starting on or after 1 August 2026, paid to you for fees and living costs, divided equally across the years of a multi-year course.
You cannot get the master's loan if you already have a master's, or have previously received a loan or grant for a master's. So only the first master's you take can use it.

Loan eligibility depends on residency (generally UK or Irish national or settled status, living in England, three years' residence) and age under 60. Check your own position on gov.uk before relying on it.
A separate Doctoral Loan of £31,122 exists for 2026/27 PhD starters, so it does not compete with the master's loan.
UKRI minimum doctoral stipend from 1 October 2026 is £23,805 with London weighting.
